title: stability-corridor-driven-autoapply-for-optimize-recommendations
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Proposal and implementation work to enable a telemetry-driven gated auto-apply flow for Optimize suggestions (batching and KV/prefix caching). Rather than a binary canary pass/fail, this ticket introduces a ‘stability corridor’ model: each recommendation is validated against multi-dimensional metric corridors (latency, tail errors, token cost delta, output-quality proxies). The system performs staged dry-runs with traffic-shape profiles (synthetic + sampled production), shows a config diff preview, and automatically escalates to an operator approval step when corridor thresholds are near edge cases. Rollback is deterministic via snapshotting of serving config + KV-cache policy and a staged unwind plan that can be executed automatically or manually.
acceptance_criteria: Stability corridor spec defined and stored in catalog for batching/caching recommendation types
Dry-run harness exists: can replay sampled traces and run synthetic traffic profiles with new config in sandboxed nodes
Config diff preview UI/CLI provides estimated cost delta, latency delta, and changed routes/models
Automated gate evaluates corridor metrics and moves suggestion through stages: dry-run -> limited rollout -> ramp -> full apply
Rollback snapshot captures prior batching/caching config and KV-cache policies and can revert within 60s for a limited rollout
Approval workflow integrates with Console: suggestion moves to operator review when corridor breaches soft thresholds and records approver decision
Telemetry alerts and audit log entries emitted for every stage transition and for rollbacks
E2E tests covering success path, corridor violation, and rollback are added to CI
tasks: Design stability corridor metric set and threshold tiers (soft/hard/critical)
Implement dry-run harness for sampled trace replay and synthetic traffic shapes
Build config diff preview generator that includes cost/capacity impact estimates
Extend rollout controller to support staged ramps tied to corridor pass rates
Implement snapshot + deterministic rollback executor for batching/cache configs
Add operator approval UI modal and Slack escalation hook
Wire telemetry: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost-per-1k, kv-cache-hit-rate, model-output-regression-proxies
Add CI tests and a small chaos experiment to validate rollback under load
